Unmodified include/ and source/SoundTouch/ compilation sources are supplied here.
The independent JNI bridge is ../../tempo_jni.cpp and the build is ../../CMakeLists.txt.
Android module: libpsxtempo.so (replaceable shared module, ARM64 and x86_64).
Build the full app with the Gradle wrapper and Android NDK 28.2, as documented in README.md.
